text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I had a dream.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Someone so beautiful, bearing a name of 
gold... is being met with thunderous 
applause in a foreign land. Her heroic 
figure makes my heart tremble and swell 
with passion...!
choice_data_list: "Someday, I too—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I woke up. Trying to calm my chest, 
which was still lingering with excitement— 
I touched a cold, intricately crafted gold 
pendant.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"About two months have passed since 
entering the Classic Year. While running 
in races, I've continued training all on 
my own, but—"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ――Haaaah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The issue where Orfevre's motivation 
drops whenever she runs alone has now...—"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Not bad.
choice_data_list: (Yeah, looks like it's stopped dropping.)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Now then.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hey. One more set.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Engrave it deeply—into your mind.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Heh—... Haaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Having gained real race experience, 
Orfevre's running was honed even 
further... showing remarkable growth day 
by day."
choice_data_list: Amazing! You beat your target time!
Amazing! You beat your target time!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I see.
choice_data_list: I can't wait. The Classic Triple Crown...!
I can't wait. The Classic Triple Crown...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...How pure and honest.
choice_data_list: (Still, she really did her best...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Normally, being in a situation without 
her vassals— without the freedom to be as 
selfish as she pleased— would have been 
quite stressful for her."
choice_data_list: Thank you, Orfe.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: What is it?
choice_data_list: Working so hard all on your own...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
choice_data_list: Shall I call in my subjects soon?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Either is fine with me.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
It may be insufficient, but it's still 
usable.
choice_data_list: Uh—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: That's all for today.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
The sun feels pleasant. I will head into 
town.
choice_data_list:
The menu is still there, for what it's 
worth, but...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I reached the goal. What more is there?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Considering her performance so far and 
that last result, wrapping things up early 
shouldn't be an issue. It's best to 
prioritize her motivation right now.
choice_data_list:
I'll adjust tomorrow's schedule after 
this.

I'll adjust tomorrow's schedule after 
this, okay?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: What are you saying?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: You are my attendant, are you not?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Follow me. Do not lag behind.
choice_data_list: …! Ah!
…! Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? They were just here a moment 
ago...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: "I wanted to ask for a tandem run, but..."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Looking for Orfevre-san? Looks like she 
went out to have some fun.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
T-Totally effortless~~...! It's actually 
kind of refreshing~...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Aah, forget it, let's just run! I'll 
surpass genius... with hard work!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After getting ready, I headed into town 
with Orfevre... and something delightful 
happened right away.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text: U-U-U-Um...! O-O-O-O-Orfevre-sama...!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Wait! S-See, your head really is held too 
high! F-Forgive us, Lady Orfevre!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I permit it. ...And what of you?

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
We are unworthy of such grace...! We are 
Lord Orfevre's loyal "subjects"...!
choice_data_list: S-Subjects?

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Since Lady Orfevre is our King, that 
makes us fans her loyal subjects, so..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's true that Orfevre referred to people 
as her subjects, but... who would have 
thought a fan would actually refer to 
herself as one?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...I see.
choice_data_list: (She looks satisfied.)
(She looks satisfied...)

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I watched your debut race and, if I may be 
so bold, it was love at first sight...!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Lady Orfevre... You'll be taking the 
Classic Triple Crown path, won't you?"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Naturally.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"The royal road is, quite simply, my 
road."

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"I can't wait to see Lady Orfevre's 
coronation...!"

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text: —Whoa!? Orfevre's actually here...!

text_block_list.name: Band Member A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's what our band's named after. 
Want me to go talk to her?

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text:
"...No, no way, absolutely not! How am I 
supposed to talk to people when I haven't 
even made it big yet?!"

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text:
Our crowds are finally picking up! Until 
our name echoes all the way to her...! 
Let's sell out, sell out, and sell like 
crazy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after parting ways with her 
passionate fans, Orfevre seemed to be in a 
surprisingly good mood.
choice_data_list:
Word of your kingly presence is really 
getting around, huh

Word of your kingly presence is really 
getting around, isn't it

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Indeed. Yet it is not enough.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
The world is full of nothing but foolish 
masses...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Orfevre glares around imperiously at her 
surroundings. All around her, ordinary 
townspeople who likely don't know who she 
is are chatting merrily."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Once I wear the Triple Crown, even the 
most ignorant will come to understand.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
The King whom they ought to worship. —I 
look forward to seeing all their foolish 
faces lined up.
choice_data_list: (This is it...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown route I've had my 
sights on for so long... First is the 
opening leg, the Satsuki Sho—as king, a 
battle I cannot afford to lose begins.
